title: Create assembler.py — knapsack budget-aware context bundling
acceptance_criteria: assemble_bundle(scored_items, token_budget) → Result[tuple[list, list], Err]: returns (bundle, near_misses)
Uses greedy knapsack: sort by relevance desc, add while under budget
near_misses = items that didn't fit but had relevance > threshold (0.3)
build_prefetch_response(bundle, near_misses, bundle_id) → dict: formatted API response
